description: The agent must: (1) Locate the SKILL.md to understand the available scripts and data formats. (2) Run `./venv/bin/python scripts/sensor_cli.py stats --since 24h` to get total_detections and unique_senders for the 24h window — it must use the bespoke `--since 24h` flag, not roll its own timestamp filtering. (3) Run `./venv/bin/python scripts/event_monitor.py` to get the incremental new_alert_count — critically, this script uses the byte offset stored in `data/monitor_state.json` so it only counts records AFTER the pre-set offset (the first 20 lines are already 'seen'), yielding a smaller number than the total. An agent that naively counts all DETECTION_SENSOR_APP records will get the wrong value for the 'unreviewed alerts' field. (4) It must also ignore non-DETECTION_SENSOR_APP records (TEXT_MESSAGE_APP, TELEMETRY_APP, POSITION_APP noise) throughout. (5) Write a valid `detection_summary.json` containing the three numeric values derived from the script outputs.
